description.zh: 用相关系数 r 说明点云多贴一条直线，用残差平方和找最小二乘线，并演示离群点与杠杆、混杂因素、非线性关系和回归到平均这几个常见陷阱。全部为种子化模拟数据，假设正态二元分布。
description.en: Use the correlation r to say how tightly a cloud follows a line, find the least-squares line by minimising squared residuals, and see the common traps: outliers and leverage, confounders, non-linear relations and regression to the mean. All data are seeded simulations assuming a bivariate normal.

label.zh: r 是归一化的协方差

reason.zh: 第 0 步把偏离乘积按各自的波动幅度（方差的平方根）归一化得到 r，是方差概念的双变量推广。
reason.en: Step 0 scales the product of deviations by each quantity’s spread (the square root of variance) to get r, a two-variable extension of variance.

label.en: Reading a relation off a slope

reason.zh: 第 1 步的拟合斜率 m 就是“x 增加 1，y 平均增加多少”，是直线斜率概念在数据上的应用。
reason.en: The fitted slope m in step 1 is “how much y rises on average per unit of x”, the straight-line slope applied to data.

title.zh: 怎样从一堆点里拉出最贴的直线？
title.en: How do you fit the best line to a cloud of points?

ask.zh: 相关系数 r 说明点云多贴一条直线——r 接近 1、接近 0 各是什么意思？
ask.en: Correlation r says how tightly a cloud follows a line — what do r near 1 and r near 0 each mean?

ask.zh: 最小二乘线是让残差平方和最小的线——为什么用平方和，不用残差的和？
ask.en: The least-squares line minimises the sum of squared residuals — why squares, not just the sum of residuals?

ask.zh: 离群点和杠杆点会把直线拉偏吗？混杂因素和非线性关系会怎样误导解读？
ask.en: Can outliers and leverage points drag the line off? How do confounders and nonlinear relations mislead the reading?

reveal.zh: r 度量贴合程度，最小二乘找残差平方和最小的线；但离群点、杠杆、混杂和非线性都会让直线误导，解读时要先看点云。
reveal.en: r measures the fit, least squares finds the line minimising squared residuals — but outliers, leverage, confounders and nonlinearity can all mislead, so look at the cloud first.
